title: leucanthemum atratum subsp. corsicum
intro: Leucanthemum atratum subsp. corsicum, commonly known as the Corsican oxeye, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family. The Corsican oxeye has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, helping to soothe digestive issues and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Leucanthemum atratum subsp. corsicum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
